errors: First venture-suite run failed one test (test_camera_profiles pinned the old refusal text that now names 3FR); fixed in the PR.
Hasselblad JPEG header parser first rejected the CFV's 0xFF fill byte after SOF3; fixed before any real-file result.
The H4D-60 first differed from LibRaw in every sensel (wrapped below-zero data); fixed by a histogram-gap test.

CI lint (mypy 1.19.1) failed once on hasselblad.py: jpeg_header's height not narrowed from None, and the np = None import pattern; fixed, checked locally with CI's ruff 0.15.8 and mypy 1.19.1 in a venv without numpy.
integrity_issues: Found that tools/mrw_develop_check.py (landed earlier today) undid LibRaw's BT.709 output with the sRGB curve, so the MRW eval's 0.003-0.016 colour gaps are overstated; recorded in eval/hasselblad-3fr-reader-2026-11-18.md and NEXT.md, not rerun (the MRW files were not re-downloaded).

doc_friction.issue: Its shallow fetch timed out at 50 s and left .git/shallow.lock behind, which made the next git fetch fail until the stale lock was removed by hand.
The develop subcommand's help still said CR3 needed converting and listed only five formats; corrected in this PR.

notes: Routed ventures/1; allocate.py picked flagship row 3 photo-editing. Chose a new raw format (Hasselblad 3FR) from the BUILDABLE HERE source raw.pixls.us. Verification: tools/hasselblad_libraw_check.py on 10 real 3FRs: 561,488,912 sensels, 0 differing, CFA and WB equal LibRaw 0.22.2 (rawpy 0.28.0). tools/hasselblad_develop_check.py --colour=dng,dcraw: all 10 under the 0.02 chroma gate (dcraw method 0.0000 on 8, 0.002-0.003 on the 100 MP two; DNG model max 0.0172 on a tungsten frame). tests/test_hasselblad.py 15 tests pass with C, with SHOOTFLOW_NATIVE=0 and with numpy. run_venture_tests.py photo-editing: ok, 1388 tests (219 s, 9 skipped), after fixing one test that pinned the old refusal text. venture-preflight.mjs photo-editing: clean.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
